name: react-render-audit
description: Measure and cut React re-renders in a real React or Next.js app without changing behavior, then prove the speed-up: /optimize-renders replays a user flow in headless Chrome, counts every component render and why, fixes the worst causes with the react-best-practices skills, proves each fix kept behavior identical, times old and new code side by side on mobile and desktop profiles with confidence intervals, and writes a before/after report.
